id: Stable identity for references and edits; never use list position or wording as identity.
name: Human-readable identity; helps the user recognize the record.
version: Contract or customization revision; prevents silent incompatible interpretation.
label: Display wording; changing it does not change assessment meaning.
definition: User-owned class meaning, passed verbatim to selection.
order: User-owned ordinal class order. Unrated stays neutral rather than lowest.
level: User assessment class ID, not factual certainty or model confidence.
note: Optional user context explaining preferred emphasis or depth.
assessed_hash: Claim revision the user assessed; detects substantive change without inventing a new rating.
definition_hash: Assessed class meaning revision; definition changes request reassessment.
kind: Semantic category used by composition or source interpretation, not an arbitrary formatting instruction.
source: Source locator, or customization function source; retain provenance and keep user code outside core.
locator: Optional page/slide/paragraph location so a claim can be reviewed.
excerpt: Optional source passage for context; a document is not independent verification.
text: Canonical wording or snapshot text. Approved claim wording is not silently rewritten.
evidence_ids: Links to supporting records, including explicit user attestation. Does not prove factual truth.
skill_ids: Supported skill catalog IDs; avoids unsupported keyword stuffing.
qualifiers: Protected literal scope/uncertainty phrases that must survive wording changes.
approval: Proposed versus approved wording; selection cannot silently publish proposed claims.
confidence: Combined user depth/defendability and preferred prominence assessment.
variants: Explicit approved alternative wordings for available space, with qualifiers preserved.
context: Contribution/exposure context for a skill, or deeper claim context without bloating a bullet.
bullets: Canonical bullet pool; one editable claim per ID rather than copied job-specific variants.
evidence: Source records that support review and attribution.
skills: Supported skill catalog in x_resume; standard groups in the JSON Resume core.
summaries: Approved reusable summaries; selection can reuse without another model call.
confidence_levels: User-owned definitions and order shared with every chooser.
$schema: Optional schema identifier; standard core is checked with pinned JSON Resume v1.0.0.
basics: JSON Resume identity/contact core, retaining upstream field types.
work: JSON Resume employment records plus x_id for stable claim ownership.
projects: JSON Resume project records plus x_id for stable claim ownership.
education: JSON Resume education records; no fabricated credentials.
volunteer: JSON Resume service/teaching records plus x_id; rendered under Projects in the default format.
certificates: Standard qualification records retained for interchange; not automatically displayed in v1.
awards: Standard award records retained for interchange; not automatically displayed in v1.
publications: Standard publication records retained for interchange; not automatically displayed in v1.
languages: Standard language records retained for interchange; not automatically displayed in v1.
interests: Standard optional interests retained for interchange; not automatically displayed in v1.
references: Standard reference records, or explicitly declared customization dependencies; enables inspection and missing-reference errors.
x_resume: Sharp extension containing reusable evidence-aware data, separate from presentation.
font: Standard PDF family or actual TTF path; measurements and export use the same font.
size: Text size in points; contributes to measured dimensions.
leading: Line height in points; controls vertical space and readability.
color: Hex text color; a geometry-preserving decoration.
bold: Explicit weight flag. Shipped hierarchy bolds names, roles, headings and degree rows; bullet phrases require explicit ranges.
italic: Explicit slant flag. False in shipped styles.
before: Space before a block in points; measured before fitting.
after: Space after a block in points; included in keep-with-next calculations.
indent: Body-text indentation in points; reduces available width and aligns wrapped list lines.
marker: Optional list label text, separate from canonical career wording; empty disables the visible marker.
marker_offset: Distance from body-text start back to marker start in points; must fit within indent and accommodate glyph width.
start: Inclusive Unicode code-point offset into snapshot text; not a UTF-16 or byte index.
end: Exclusive Unicode code-point offset; changes to text require range review.
style: Effective style or range patch; validate supported properties before applying.
runs: Snapshot-specific text ranges and style patches; later ranges win for overlapping properties.
source_ids: Stable source references for provenance of rendered content.
url: Actual link destination; exporters retain link relationships.
width: Measured width or page width in points; necessary for deterministic wrapping.
height: Measured height or page height in points; necessary for fitting.
margins: Top/right/bottom/left margins in points; define usable page area.
max_pages: Hard page ceiling of one or two; never silently exceed it.
fill_targets: Soft desired used-height fractions per page; missing later targets repeat the last.
required: Bullet IDs that must fit or generation fails with an explanation.
excluded: Bullet IDs that must not appear, regardless of model rank or user confidence.
requires: A-to-supporting-B dependencies; closure is enforced if A is included.
purpose: User intent/comment, kept with function implementation for sharing and review.
enabled: Whether a compiled customization participates in a run.
stage: Selection postprocessing, before-layout changes, or after-layout paint; determines its input/output contract.
page: Page settings or one-based placed page number, according to the record type.
styles: Default semantic styles; local settings are complete, not merged with hidden templates.
exceptions: Per-block style overrides keyed by stable ID; global edits preserve them unless explicitly cleared.
section_order: Display order for supported summary/work/projects/education/skills sections.
experience_first: Editable inclusion preference. True ships by default; display order is still independent.
skills_fill_target: Desired final skills-line width fraction; no artificial spacing or unsupported filler.
skills_max_lines: Maximum skill lines; only ranked supported skills are considered.
selection_instructions: Editable selection policy text supplied to the chosen AI adapter.
customizations: Ordered named function definitions and source in the one local file.
contract_version: Input contract revision for external agents/rules.
career: Validated career snapshot; a provider cannot overwrite it through choice output.
job: Cached posting text or creation input URL/text; treated as untrusted source data.
instructions: Effective user selection policy; avoids application-specific hardcoding.
constraints: Explicit content requirements; contradictory mandatory requests fail rather than silently relaxing.
settings: Complete effective settings snapshot for this invocation; no hidden runtime template merge.
confidence_review: Bullet-ID flags for stale user assessments; not a fabricated replacement rating.
candidate_id: Approved bullet ID; no new claim text is accepted in selection output.
variant_id: Optional approved wording variant ID for the same bullet.
requirement_ids: Job requirement references for inspectable alignment.
reason: Optional concise justification supplied by its actual source, not hidden chain-of-thought.
provider_confidence: Optional provider-native uncertainty with its original shape; not the user's assessment.
ranked: Ordered relevant candidates and reserves so fitting needs no further AI call.
summary_id: Approved summary ID; omitted means no summary was chosen.
provider: Actual choice source, e.g. user, ACP, or LiteLLM.
model: Provider model identity when known; not guessed.
provider_version: Optional provider adapter/backend version when reported; supports reproducibility.
raw_response_ref: Optional local raw response artifact reference, kept outside routine trace logs.
requirements: Identified job requirement ID-to-text map for decision references.
usage: Reported provider usage only. Missing monetary cost means unknown, not zero.
patches: Block-ID-to-style changes. Text changes belong in reviewed career proposals.
colors: Placed-block color changes after fitting; cannot change dimensions.
available_width: Actual space for the line in points, permitting remaining-width calculation.
block_id: Stable document block reference for measured lines.
lines: Exact wrapped text/ranges/widths shared by measurement, export and inspection.
block: Effective block snapshot placed on the page.
x: Left coordinate in points from page left.
y: Top coordinate in points from page top.
measurement: Exact lines and dimensions associated with the placed block.
measurements: Pre-fit probe measurements for custom formatting. Changes are measured again; these are not final placements.
document: Ordered candidate blocks before fitting, including approved reserves for rules to require.
input: Complete typed choice input supplied to a selection postprocessor.
plan: Current validated choice plan; each subsequent selection hook sees prior hook output.
placed: Ordered positioned blocks; this order is the PDF reading order.
pages: Actual rendered page count, checked against the ceiling.
selected_ids: Bullet IDs finally admitted by fitting, in display order.
omitted_ids: Candidate IDs absent from final output; inspect alongside selection and constraints.
page_fill: Actual used-height fractions, without implying the target is always attainable.
remaining_height: Remaining usable height per page in points.
skills_line_fill: Final skills-line used-width fraction; remaining width is inspectable in its measured line.
issues: Explicit fit/fill limitations; never hide them by fabricating content.
instruction: User's requested wording change, separate from selection.
target_ids: Stable IDs permitted for a requested edit.
target_id: Existing claim being proposed for revision; prevents cross-owner substitutions.
base_hash: Career revision approved by the user; stale proposals cannot overwrite newer changes.
changes: Reviewable source-linked wording proposals, atomically validated before approval.
document_type: Resume or cover letter; no unsolicited document generation.
career_path: Local career input path; user data stays untracked.
settings_path: The single authoritative settings file, or a saved run snapshot during edits.
output_dir: Dedicated generated-run directory; successful staged runs replace it atomically.
formats: Explicit requested formats; PDF is the only default.
selection_path: Optional saved ChoicePlan; bypasses provider invocation.
title: Human-readable target title used in filenames; path-unsafe characters are removed.
letter_text: Agent/user-supplied cover letter draft; never a fabricated generic achievement template.
path: Absolute generated artifact location for delivery.
format: Artifact format identifier; allows clients to choose which outputs to show.
checks: Completed checks and known fidelity limits, not a universal ATS guarantee.
run_id: Unique execution identity for stage tracking and inspection.
artifacts: Files produced only for requested formats plus available previews.
layout: Complete saved placement snapshot; exports can reuse it without inference.
timings: Measured seconds by stage; provider latency is distinguished from local rendering.
